located_observations.observation: Large date leads one close left-aligned market/hours/venue group. Numeric periods, longer range dash and hours colons remain distinct.
Slogan opens three full readable body lines; access and care directly below share the start axis. Paragraph and practical information use stable upright Korean glyphs and natural word spaces.
Three alternating image openings and the date/body/identity turns are visible; repotting images are substantive parts of the edited page, not small embellishments of an information board.
Palm supports the soil-root cylinder; stabilizing fingers and forearms connect visibly. Root strands and mottled pothos leaves repeat across the two views, with a plain receiving pot alongside.
Both hands grip the plain pot; plant is seated in soil. The base is cropped at the bottom edge, limiting independent assessment of the complete base-to-table contact.
Natural green leaves, tan skin and brown pot/soil remain. Requested monochrome with blue-separated shadows was not implemented.
Text is flat and untextured, with clear counters; rectangular image cuts are crisp. No extra print/logo/QR is visible.
